newest.RootCause:
Creative Reel Apply Effect lost its answer (Wi-Fi off), and the session status could not be read either. The pack was kept in UPLOAD for My AI Artwork to follow. Yet the confirm page showed the apply-failed dialog: "Unsuccessful, please try again. Credits refunded." Nothing had been refunded: the credit may have been spent.

AI Transition and CineStory show the same dialog when their Apply Effect gets no usable answer, although both charged at Create Session.
newest.Solution:
An Apply Effect without a usable answer (no answer, a 5xx, a 401, or an answer that cannot be read) now ends in NETWORK_ERROR. The confirm page then shows the existing network error: a dialog without a connection, a toast with one. Packs and the Artwork follow-up are unchanged.
- ReelCreatorGenerateUseCase.applyUnconfirmed:
  - AI Transition returns NETWORK_ERROR;
  - Creative Reel returns NETWORK_ERROR when the session status cannot tell;
  - when the status shows the Apply Effect was not taken, Creative Reel still discards the pack and returns APPLY_EFFECT_FAILED.
- AICineStoryGenerateUseCase.applyEffect:
  - a 2xx whose body cannot be read or parsed is treated as no answer;
  - the NETWORK_ERROR it throws for no answer is no longer turned into APPLY_EFFECT_FAILED.
- Refused requests (400 / 403 / 422) keep APPLY_EFFECT_FAILED, or NO_ENOUGH_CREDIT for Creative Reel's charged 403.
- Tests:
  - The Creative, Transition and CineStory use case tests now expect NETWORK_ERROR for the unanswered cases.
  - The CineStory no-answer case stubs the API service.
  - A CineStory case with an unreadable answer is added.
  - The changed cases failed before the fix.
